instr: Flashing T's: keep your eyes on the centre and say which way the middle T of a small group faces.
clue: Keep your eyes on the cross in the middle the whole time. A small group of T shapes will flash briefly to one side. Say which way the flat bar of the MIDDLE T faces: up, right, down or left. Use the arrow keys or the buttons. If you are not sure, make your best guess. Press Start when ready.
stage_label: A cross in the middle of an empty area
